name: Cham Islands food guide
summary: The plate is the catch: fish, shrimp, squid, and swimming crab, with rice and little spice. Mực một nắng is tube squid dried one sun. Breakfast stalls line the Bai Lang coast road. Lunch sits around 11:00–12:00. No stall price was printed.
body: Eat the catch with rice. The 15 September 2025 study names fish soup, fish braised lightly, fish braised salty, fried fish, grilled dried fish, and dried fish simmered again. Chả cá is the fish paste: fried, in soup, with tomato, or as the filling of bánh canh and bánh xèo. Afternoon choices on that page include bánh xèo chả cá, bánh canh, bánh bèo, and mì Quảng.

Mực một nắng is the dish with a photograph: tube squid dried one sun. Yến sào is a geographic indication registered on 23 November 2020. The city page quotes grades from nearly 100 million to nearly 180 million VND a kilogram. That is not a bowl price. Nước lá Lao, bánh ít, and bánh su sê are named on the 2014 note and have no method and no price there.
specialtiesLead: The dish with a photograph. The rest of the meal is the catch, named on the place page.

sections.heading: Bai Lang coast road
paragraphs: The 15 September 2025 study places breakfast stalls along the Bai Lang coast road and by the well in Bai Ong. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00. No stall price was printed. Household names on that page are not picks.
